units.title: I believe in God
units.eq: What does it mean to believe?

lessons.title: The Creed: a summary of our faith
lessons.idea: The Creed is a short statement of what the Church believes. We say it at Mass.
lessons.question: Why do we say the Creed together?
lessons.activity: Put the Apostles’ Creed phrases in order. Learn the first section by heart.

lessons.title: Faith: a gift and a choice
lessons.idea: Faith is trusting God and believing what he reveals. It is a gift and also our free response.
lessons.question: Who is an example of faith in the Bible?
lessons.activity: Study Abraham and Mary as models of faith; write a one-paragraph reflection.

lessons.title: One God in three Persons
lessons.idea: We believe in one God: Father, Son and Holy Spirit. The Trinity is the central mystery of faith.
lessons.question: Why is the Trinity a mystery?
lessons.activity: Compare analogies for the Trinity, noting where each falls short.

lessons.title: God made everything good
lessons.idea: God created out of nothing and out of love. Creation is good and ordered.
lessons.question: What does Genesis teach about creation?
lessons.activity: Compare a poem about creation with a science fact; discuss how they differ.

lessons.title: Angels and humans
lessons.idea: God made angels and humans. Angels are spirit creatures who serve God. Humans have body and soul.
lessons.question: What are the differences between angels and people?
lessons.activity: Create a chart: body, soul, angels.

lessons.title: The fall and God’s promise
lessons.idea: Adam and Eve sinned. Sin entered the world. God promised a Redeemer.
lessons.question: What does “original sin” mean?
lessons.activity: Study a timeline of the fall to the promise.

lessons.title: Conceived by the Holy Spirit
lessons.idea: The Son of God became man. He was born of the Virgin Mary.
lessons.question: What does “incarnation” mean?
lessons.activity: Compare Gospel infancy accounts and make a chart of what each tells.

lessons.title: Suffered, died, rose
lessons.idea: Jesus suffered under Pontius Pilate, was crucified, died, was buried and rose on the third day.
lessons.question: Why did Jesus have to suffer?
lessons.activity: Create a Holy Week reading plan.

lessons.title: Ascended and will come again
lessons.idea: Jesus ascended to the Father. He will come again to judge the living and the dead.
lessons.question: What will happen at the end of time?
lessons.activity: Write what “Jesus will come again” means for us.

units.title: The Holy Spirit and the Church
units.eq: Who is the Holy Spirit and what is the Church?

lessons.title: The Holy Spirit gives life
lessons.idea: The Holy Spirit is God. He gives life, inspires Scripture and guides the Church.
lessons.question: Where do we see the Spirit at work?
lessons.activity: Study the symbols of the Spirit: dove, fire, wind, oil.

lessons.title: The Church as the Body of Christ
lessons.idea: The Church is one body with Jesus as the head. All members are needed.
lessons.question: What is your part in the body?
lessons.activity: Make a body diagram of the parish.

lessons.title: Marks of the Church
lessons.idea: The Church is one, holy, catholic and apostolic. These marks come from Christ.
lessons.question: Which mark do you notice most?
lessons.activity: Find examples of each mark in your parish.

units.title: Communion of saints and life everlasting

lessons.title: Communion of saints
lessons.idea: All members of Christ are connected. The saints in heaven pray for us.
lessons.question: How do you ask the saints to pray?
lessons.activity: Write a litany with five saints.

lessons.title: Forgiveness of sins
lessons.idea: God forgives sins through Baptism and Reconciliation.
lessons.question: Why does the Church forgive sins?
lessons.activity: Role-play a short Confession with a puppet priest.

lessons.title: Resurrection of the body and life everlasting
lessons.idea: At the end we will rise. The faithful live with God forever.
lessons.question: What does the Creed promise?
lessons.activity: Meditate on Revelation 21:1-5; sketch your hopes for heaven.

lessons.title: Immaculate Conception
lessons.idea: Mary was conceived without original sin by God’s grace.
lessons.question: Why did God prepare Mary this way?
lessons.activity: Study the angel’s greeting and the feast on December 8.

lessons.title: Mother of God
lessons.idea: Mary is the Mother of God because Jesus is God.
lessons.question: How does this protect the truth about Jesus?
lessons.activity: Learn about the Council of Ephesus in a short timeline.

lessons.title: Assumption and Queen of Heaven
lessons.idea: Mary was taken body and soul into heaven.
lessons.question: What does the Assumption show us?
lessons.activity: Trace Marian feasts on the church calendar.

units.title: The Sacraments (overview) and moral life
units.eq: How does God give us life and a path?

lessons.title: Seven sacraments
lessons.idea: Christ instituted the sacraments. Each gives grace through a sign.
lessons.question: What are the three groups of sacraments?
lessons.activity: Match sacraments with their signs and effects.

lessons.title: Virtues and conscience
lessons.idea: Virtues are habits that help us do good. Conscience guides our choices.
lessons.question: Which habit would you like to grow?
lessons.activity: Create a habit tracker for one virtue.

lessons.title: Beatitudes and Commandments
lessons.idea: The Beatitudes and Commandments show how to love.
lessons.question: How are they connected?
lessons.activity: Draw a bridge between a commandment and a beatitude.

units.title: Prayer and Church year
units.eq: How do we live the faith each day?

lessons.title: Praying the Our Father
lessons.idea: The Our Father is the summary of the Gospel. Each petition has meaning.
lessons.question: Which petition is most meaningful to you?
lessons.activity: Paraphrase each petition in your own words.

lessons.title: Forms and expressions of prayer
lessons.idea: We pray in blessing, adoration, petition, intercession, thanksgiving and praise. We use vocal prayer, meditation, contemplation.
lessons.question: Which form of prayer helps you most?
lessons.activity: Try a lectio divina with a Gospel passage.

lessons.title: Liturgical year and the Mass
lessons.idea: The Church year celebrates the mystery of Christ. The Mass is the center.
lessons.question: What is the structure of the Mass?
lessons.activity: Create a diagram of the Mass.
